key_insight: Lean 4.0 maintenance practices reduced reported welding-machine downtime by 375 minutes per year in a continuous steel galvanizing line.
engineering_relevance: Standardized disc replacement, machine checklists, and staff training can improve welding-machine reliability and production continuity.
method: Conducted an empirical case study of a galvanizing-line welding machine.
Standardized welding-disc replacement and introduced a machine checklist.
Trained staff to support consistent maintenance practices.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a 375-minute annual reduction in total welding-machine downtime, compared with a historical baseline of 496 minutes per year specifically attributed to welding-disc failures.
watch_item: This single-machine case study uses differently scoped downtime measures and does not specify which Industry 4.0 technologies were deployed.
paper_title: Lean maintenance 4.0: Enhancing welding machine reliability in steel galvanizing processes
